caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic plate with a reddish-brown rim and a partially greenish-yellow background. Inside the plate is a stylized bird, likely a peacock, oriented to the right. The bird has green and brown feathers, an orange-brown marking on its wing, and a tail with line patterns. Three circular shapes top the bird’s head like a crown or crest. To the left of the bird, there are large, brown and green stylized leaves and a flower with both curved and pointed petals. In the upper right section of the plate, there is a scroll-like design bearing the inscription "1793." The bottom of the image shows the plate in profile, emphasizing its curved shape and reddish-brown underside. The composition is framed by a simple outline on a beige background.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
